decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is part of the firm's core coolant management offer, into which the firm has invested and committed publicly, so it stays in the portfolio.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the announced filtering and sustainability direction, so any weak results would be attributed to market ramp-up and the product kept.
The nozzle line is a low-cost, visible complement to the coolant systems, so management would at most trim individual models rather than drop the line.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the established conveying business and central to the firm's identity.
The magnetic belt conveyor serves metalworking customers directly and builds on prior investment in the chip conveyor range, so it is retained.
Hinged belt conveyors are a core standard product of the firm's material flow offer, so retiring them is very unlikely.
